prompts.jets: Production sprite animation sheet for a hand-drawn colored-pencil 2D action platformer: EXACTLY FOUR frames of TWIN ROCKET-BOOT EXHAUST ONLY. Use the supplied red/orange winged Ember Boots pickup solely as the color/material/style reference; DO NOT draw boots, feet, legs, people, machines or any other object. Each animation frame contains two parallel horizontal flames, close together vertically, one slightly offset behind the other. Both have a compact WHITE-HOT / pale-yellow ignition tip on the RIGHT edge, then a very LONG tapered golden-orange and red flame jet streaming LEFT. Crisp irregular pencil/ink contour, colored-pencil hatching, several lively jagged tongues and tiny close orange cinders. Flames read as forceful rocket thrust pushing a running hero RIGHT. All four frame pairs share exactly the same right-end ignition anchor, same vertical spacing and overall scale; flicker tongues vary subtly, no growth/shrink zoom. Each frame pair is about four times wider than tall, with visible spacing between the two flames. Arrange exactly four independent twin-flame pairs in a spacious TWO-COLUMN TWO-ROW grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom, landscape 1536x1024 canvas. Keep at least 50px fully transparent padding between each pair and its slot edges, no connected neighbors, no ground, scenery, text, labels, grid lines, border, gradient glow or backdrop. Native transparent alpha background. Full strip at once, production sprite tone, no poster composition.
prompts.xgod: Production sprite animation sheet: EXACTLY FOUR full-body frames of the SAME approved X God from the first reference, now activating the red-orange Ember Boots from the second reference. Preserve his lime green spiky hair, black X eyes, compact childlike doodle proportions, white short-sleeved shirt with yellow X-face smiley emblem, orange cargo pants, thick hand-drawn black outlines and colored-pencil texture. Replace ONLY his sneakers with chunky red-orange running rocket boots with yellow flame-shaped heel fins and dark soles matching the second reference. Face RIGHT in all four frames. Four coherent flowing dash-loop poses: 1: athletic forward lean, elbows bent, red boots planted/staggered ready to thrust; 2: strong low forward lean, front knee forward and rear leg trailing, both boots clearly visible; 3: maintain same forward lean with a small swapped leg/arm phase, boots point forward; 4: maintain forward momentum with front leg extended and trailing leg bent, ready to cycle to pose1. Same anatomy scale, head size, outfit, face, right facing and foot baseline throughout. No weapons, no blaster or sword, no long flame trails or separate sparks (the engine adds exhaust separately), no extra accessories. Show every boot fully with no cropping. Exactly four separate poses in a roomy TWO-COLUMN TWO-ROW grid, reading left-right then top-bottom, landscape 1536x1024 canvas. At least 50px transparent gutters on all sides of each pose; no touching cells, no labels, text, ground, shadow, glow, grid lines, scenery or backdrop. Native transparent alpha. Entire animation sheet in one generation, clean game-ready sprite art.
